head: 6e5c1e5fcc7e308b0698414693dc734ecc992e8f
summary:
This is a stale re-validation at 6e5c1e5. My last pass was at 199f0e1. Since then the branch has had one uat merge (67951a8, which brings in SL-073) and build attempt 8, which changed only .taad/slices/SL-069/index.json.

**What changed.** The diff 199f0e1..6e5c1e5 limited to tests/rules, tests/bugs, eng, .taad/fitness.yaml, ArchitectureRulesTests.cs and src is empty. SL-073 changed:
- Directory.Build.props: it now pins FsaSmbLibraryVersion and FsaSmbLibraryWin32Version.
- The Core.Tests csproj and StallRig.csproj, which now take those properties.
- TestNative.cs (a new SizeOnDisk helper), plus SmbLibraryPinTests.cs, TempTree.cs, TempTreeTests.cs and WindowCasesHelperTests.cs.
- tests/window.

**Where the two slices meet.** The only real meeting point is the scratch copy that the harness and the EngineCases shape build. Both copy `git ls-files -co --exclude-standard` (harness.py:187, RuleCases.ps1:94, sibling test :103), so the new Directory.Build.props goes with the csproj that needs it. I measured that rather than assuming it (see the checks).

**Re-run on the merged tree, all green:**
- **Parity:** AGREE 11/15/27/49 under powershell.exe and pwsh.
- **C-001 to C-005:** exit 0 under both hosts, with ok counts 8, 34, 26, 26 and 230, the same as last pass.
- **C-006 and C-009 with the engine:** exit 0 under both hosts.
- **EngineCases:** exit 0 in 322 s with 29 ok. C-007 and C-008 pass on this tree and on the 12/17/28 two-scope copy, under both hosts.
- **All ten non-engine sibling shapes:** each exits 0 with 0 FAIL.
- **SettledCountProbe:** Misclassified and GuardRule both exit 0.
- **Harness `--scenario all`:** 48/48 AS-RECORDED. The 577-file scratch copy builds in 6 s.
- **Fitness:** all 64 rules hold.
- **Default suite:** 400/400. That is 394 plus SL-073's 6 new tests.
- **Design case 14 on my own scratch copy:** I added a [Theory] with three InlineData rows. The chain fails loudly (parity CANNOT-READ, C-001 and C-007 exit 1). It does not report a false count.

**What I assumed.** The bug report is only a title. I took as acceptance the engine's repro (O-001, exit 0 on record; the file is unchanged and I did not re-run it), the slice's two statements, the C-003 lookahead that was cut as already built (still at line 332), and the design's 14 cases. The block of cases is headed 'What this slice has to do, as the design fixed it', not 'What this slice owes', and it has 14 items, more than `planned` can hold. So `planned` is empty and the cases are graded under `criteria`.

**This slice is in a loop.** Validate attempts 2 to 6, code-review attempts 2 to 6 and build attempts 4 to 8 were all taken back as STALE because uat moved (SL-070 to SL-073) or a build landed. None of those merges touched a file SL-069 owns. Build 8 changed no code and neither did this pass. Every lap re-runs about 15 minutes of engine-backed checks to confirm an overlap that is empty. A merge step that checks file overlap first, or merges out straight after the uat-in merge, would stop the loop. That decision belongs to a person.

**Clean-up.** No fsa-* folder was created in %TEMP% (1509 before and after). My sl069-validate6 scratch and its log are removed, no process I started is still alive, and git status shows only the engine's .taad files.
